plan.summary: This 1-4 block is the opening building phase of a 12-week off-camp boxing plan. Week 1 establishes training maxes for the main percentage-based lifts with one assessment lift per session, then Weeks 2-4 build general strength, simple explosive work, and a small amount of conditioning that fits short 30-minute sessions. The goal is to raise your force ceiling now, keep some speed in the week, and arrive at Week 5 ready to intensify without carrying excess fatigue.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general strength and simple power while establishing baseline numbers and keeping conditioning supportive.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main lifts and power work with slightly higher intensity while keeping fatigue recoverable around boxing.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Shift more of the work toward fast, sharp force expression while maintaining enough strength to support it.
